name: LLM-jp-4.1 (32B-A3B, 33B, 8B thinking)
vendor: NII Research and Development Center for LLMs (LLM-jp)

lineage.how_derived: pretraining and mid-training for the base; post-trained with SFT and DPO, no reinforcement learning; 32B-A3B, 33B and 8B thinking models

purpose: Japanese-focused open models from the National Institute of Informatics; the card refers to a (Japanese) technical blog and a cookbook for use (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (card tag)
license.notes: Card tag apache-2.0; no LICENSE file in the repo, text not read.

architecture.attention: GQA 40 Q / 4 KV heads, head dim 128, hidden 2560

variants.notes: 7.6k downloads; 33B and 8B thinking GGUF repos also exist (sizes not checked)

pc-12gb.notes: 21.52 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~3 B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-16gb.notes: 21.52 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~3 B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-24gb.notes: 21.52 GB file against 21.6 GB VRAM plus 82 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~3 B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-32gb.notes: 21.52 GB file fits the VRAM budget (29.6 GB) with room for KV

mac-16-24gb.notes: 21.52 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 21.52 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 21.52 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

weaknesses: evaluation only in a Japanese blog (not read)

tona_fit.reason: Candidate for Japanese-language users on 16 GB class hardware (plain qwen3moe, 3B active, 65k context). No numbers read, so no offer.

open_questions: Japanese benchmark results versus Qwen3.8 models
